title: Note on higher spins and holographic symmetry algebra
summary: In this paper we discuss a higher spin extension of the holographic symmetry algebra for graviton and gluon. Our primary observation is that in the presence of higher spin particles the soft symmetry algebra has a subalgebra isomorphic to $w_{\infty}$ which is generated by the \textit{conformally soft higher spin particles}. This $w_{\infty}$ subalgebra does not commute with the $w_{1+\infty}$ subalegbra generated by the conformally soft gravitons. The same thing holds for the colored higher spin particles.
